answer: The price of trying is 30 letters of reference, each one priced at £44, paid up front for every single name, while the lagoon stays small. A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. The desk only stamps a name that carries Woolbound stocking room keeper damask licence, and the stamp itself rests on a licence stocking room keepers carry after cloth room audits. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. The vertex is on the docket. nectar stays on the record.
